verdict.rationale: Phaser is a code-first JS/TS framework driven entirely through a documented programmatic API: concept docs cover Scenes, game objects (e.g. `this.add.sprite`), physics, the loader and the Animation Manager, and full TypeScript definitions ship with the package. For agent use, an official MCP server exposes 40+ tools, and a runtime probe found an examples API index (`GET /api/v1/examples/{id}`) via phaser.io/llms.txt. Missing for 10: no machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), no dedicated API-reference pages cited (only concept guides), and community reports that the documentation is poor or outdated temper confidence in its completeness.
